items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 1 at 1:25PM EST until November 2 at 3:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas up to 6 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina and Northeast South Carolina
coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM EST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
